Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-cyokotto-wakoucha/

Spot creatures in the waterways of the Haraichiba area, and as a collaboration project, you'll also make hand-rolled Japanese black tea using Hanno tea.

【Fee】
¥2,500 per person, ¥5,000 per family (includes guide fee, instructor fee, and insurance)

【Capacity】
12 people

【Guide】
Kojima Tsubasa (Hanno City Ecotourism Citizen Guide Association – Creatures Section)

【What to Bring】
• Drinking water
• Towel
• Work gloves (cotton gloves, etc.)
• Insect repellent
• Rain gear
• Child's life jacket if available (loaner jackets also provided)
• Small net or collection case if available (loaner equipment also provided)
• Clothes suitable for getting wet (avoid exposing too much skin)
• Non-slip shoes suitable for wading in water up to knee depth (no long boots or sandals)
• Hat
location: 集合 原市場地区行政センター玄関前（国際興業バス「石原橋」下車徒歩3分） ※原市場福祉センター閉館につき集合場所が変更になりました。
summary: Easy-Going Tour: Creature Spotting at Haraichiba & Making Hand-Rolled Japanese Black Tea
